entities.summary: Emma Elisabeth Nordin is a former Swedish ice hockey forward and member of the Swedish national ice hockey team, who last played in the Swedish Women's Hockey League (SDHL) with Luleå HF/MSSK. Often cited as one of the best Swedish players in women's ice hockey, she has twice been named Swedish Player of the Year, is a five-time SDHL champion, the second-highest scorer in SDHL history, and has made over 200 international appearances for Sweden. Emma Nordin announced her retirement on the 21st of May, 2025.³
